caption: The drawing features a single, bonnet-shaped object occupying the left-central portion of the image, set against a plain, light beige background. The bonnet is oriented with its rounded edge facing left and a small curved indentation along the lower right edge, suggesting an opening for the face. The bonnet is decorated with multiple horizontal bands filled with intricate, repetitive looped and interwoven patterns, colored primarily in shades of light yellow and gold. Along the outermost edge, there is a border of circular loops, creating a scalloped effect. The surface of the bonnet is divided by slightly darker, thin vertical and diagonal lines, separating sections with different detailed designs. There are no other objects, figures, or additional decorative elements in the image.
title: Bonnet
